aggregate.pair_aggregation_rule: For each common service pair, average its train and test delta; aggregate that per-pair value across the same common pair population.

sensitivity_to_channel_inclusion.inclusion_rule: same common pair set and same time split; only DST_IP participation changes

bound_convention.joint_confidence_statement: Each arm's per-pair upper side uses alpha=0.025 for each of the two laws, giving the repository's 0.95 union-bound convention.
bound_convention.lower_endpoint: 0.0 trivial nonnegative TV lower bound; no classifier-based lower side is computed by this runner

design.arm_a: partition symbol is pack_rung_prefix(PPI, k=5, M=1, direction_row=1, size_row=2)
design.arm_b: partition symbol is (arm_a packed prefix, fixed-width DST_IP storage value)
design.host_identifier_inclusion_rule: DST_IP participates for every eligible flow in ARM B; it is absent from ARM A
design.split_policy: flow-disjoint AND time-disjoint; packet-level splitting prohibited

object_declaration: ARM A (SNI-EXCLUDED) and ARM B (SNI-INCLUSIVE) are laws over the SAME object: the same flow rows, the same (direction,size) k=5 prefix observations, and the same service-pair population, differing ONLY by whether the SNI-derived destination-host identifier DST_IP participates in the partition; the delta is therefore a LIKE-FOR-LIKE comparison.

source.ppi_row_convention: row 0 timing excluded; row 1 direction; row 2 size
